purpose: Test whether one native downstream answer-margin reader vector per row predicts the complete grouped-MLP6--7 by E/A/U/W causal composition lattice on new text.
data_status: PROSPECTIVE_INTERMEDIATE_CAUSAL_OUTCOMES; empty/EAUW endpoints are already open, but all 14 intermediate background outcomes on this authority remain unopened; an immutable 512-value prediction receipt must precede their evaluation

binding_parent.finding: Separate midpoint readers prospectively generate empty and EAUW amplitudes at 0.000116 relative L2 error.

novelty_audit: Searches for single-gradient lattice, central-gradient composition, one-reader subset prediction, and full-lattice JVP found no prior authority event.
Earlier composition laws either consume target endpoints or use a distinct midpoint derivative per background. Here one row-level reader vector must serve all sixteen backgrounds.
map: For every row, construct all 32 L11H3 heads h_base(S), h_exact(S) for S subset {E,A,U,W}. Define a target-free center c as their arithmetic mean. Differentiate the native final answer margin once at c to obtain reader g_c. Seal q_hat(S)=g_c dot (h_exact(S)-h_base(S)) for all 16 subsets. A native empty-base gradient supplies the matched one-reader control. Only after sealing 512 predictions may the complete 1,024-installation causal lattice be opened.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_and_temporal_seal: Hashes and capability license match; prediction receipt predates validation; source/downstream closures <=5e-5; exactly 512 unique predictions and targets.
predictions.pred_b_single_reader_full_lattice: Across all 512 amplitudes, central-reader cosine >=0.995, relative L2 error <=0.05, and sign agreement >=0.95.
predictions.pred_c_unopened_intermediate_composition: On the 448 previously unopened intermediate amplitudes alone, cosine >=0.99, relative L2 error <=0.08, and sign agreement >=0.90.
predictions.pred_d_direction_template_stability: Each of four direction-template cells has cosine >=0.98 and relative L2 error <=0.10.
predictions.pred_e_cardinality_stability: Each of five background-cardinality groups has cosine >=0.98 and relative L2 error <=0.10.
predictions.pred_f_center_beats_native_base_reader: The central reader reduces overall relative L2 error at least 30% versus the one-reader gradient at each row's native empty-base head.

null: Failure of b or c means one row-level reader is insufficient for composition; retain background-specific midpoint readers. Failure of d/e localizes nonlinearity to syntax/direction or lattice depth. Failure of f means the simpler native-base reader is adequate. No fitted scale, offset, causal endpoint, or group mean may alter a gate.
